text: hey if i have a mesh like this here [Image #1] and then i save it such as heroin_bob_head can i then make more edits to this, and save as something else and it will keep both or no?
resolution: Question, not a code change: answered how model save identity works. Save is keyed by the model's internal id (modelPackageStore.claimPackageDir resolves the existing home dir first), so renaming a saved model and saving again writes the SAME package dir — it renames, it does not fork. To keep both, the fork move is the Duplicate action (AppFrame duplicateModel → copyModelPackage), which copies the whole package directory on disk with its own manifest/name per req_2620/req_2168; edit the copy afterward and both survive.
